behavior: A first purchase reserves a unique current subscription row before provider writes. Retries use that persisted row ID as the Stripe idempotency key.
Provider metadata recovers a successful creation after a lost database save. Unresolved creation attempts older than 23 hours fail closed rather than reuse an expired Stripe idempotency key.

Landlord/Agency and monthly/yearly changes replace the existing subscription item. Stripe always invoices prorations immediately; the new tier takes effect only when the pending update is applied after payment.

Pending payment retries reuse the existing invoice. A different change is blocked while an update is pending. An unpaid initial subscription must be completed or explicitly canceled before changing its plan.
Current entitlement is derived from the actual provider item, not the requested tier or stale subscription metadata.

Homeowner webhooks retrieve current Stripe state and synchronize the subscription and profile atomically. Historical subscription events and stale activation after terminal cancellation cannot restore access.
Cancellation retries recover a provider cancellation that succeeded before local persistence failed.
Direct client subscription mutations are revoked and restricted; existing server-mediated web/mobile calls remain available.
Existing orphaned or multiple provider subscriptions are held for reconciliation; no automatic bulk cancellation is performed.
